# Aura Court

> Aura Court is a Vietnamese sports-court booking platform (badminton, pickleball, tennis, football, table tennis and more): browse venues, see live availability, hold a slot and pay by QR. This site is a demo; prices and bookings are sample data.

The interface is in Vietnamese with an English option. Booking and payment need a signed-in account.

## Pages

- [Home](https://court.ziet.dev/): featured courts and a quick availability search
- [Courts](https://court.ziet.dev/courts): every court with sport, area and hourly price
- [About](https://court.ziet.dev/about): the venues and how booking works
